;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Slovak presidential election]]
**[[Progressive Slovakia]] candidate [[Zuzana Čaputová]], who ran on an [[anti-corruption]] campaign against the backdrop of [[Murder of Ján Kuciak|Ján Kuciak's murder]], wins the first round of [[2019 Slovak presidential election|Slovakia's presidential election]] with 40.5% of the vote while the ruling [[Direction – Social Democracy|Direction – Social Democracy Party]]'s candidate [[Maroš Šefčovič]] receives 18.6% of the vote. As no candidate reached 50%+1 votes in the first round, Čaputová and Šefčovič will take part in a second round on March 30, 2019. The ruling Direction – Social Democracy Party suffers its worst result since its founding in 1999. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-slovakia-election-president/anti-graft-campaigner-wins-first-round-of-slovak-presidential-vote-idUSKCN1QW2Z3 (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/17/slovakia-pro-eu-zuzana-caputova-wins-first-round-of-presidential-election (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47599946 (BBC News)] [http://www.volbysr.sk/en/data01.html (Slovakia's Election Commission)]
